nodes.svg_description: Subtle square grid covering the entire canvas: vertical and horizontal lines every 160px with 2px stroke in #C9D7C1 on a flat #DBE7D1 background.

Hand-drawn white doodles near the title: at right, an open-outline heart (stroke #FFFFFF, 6px) about 200x240px, tilted 10° clockwise; at left of the jar, three short accent dashes (stroke #FFFFFF, 6px, rounded caps), each ~30–50px, radiating slightly upward.
Large rounded rectangle instruction panel with 24px corner radius, filled #FFFFFF and no stroke.

nodes.asset_description: Center illustration of a hand-drawn glass jar with thick dark green outline (#2B4E43). The jar body is white with a few interior accent strokes (#2B4E43). The metal lid is a flattened oval top in warm amber (#F0BD63) with dark green rim lines. Inside the jar are four puffy hearts with a sticker-like white border: two red hearts (#D4433F) and two golden hearts (#F4C069) arranged diagonally. Beneath the jar sits a wide elliptical shadow/placemat in muted sage green (#8EA993) with a darker rim (#6E8C78), centered under the jar and overlapping the top of the white panel slightly.

nodes.svg_description: Decorative step numerals and underline in a hand-drawn style: a large '1', '2', and '3' each filled #A9C7A7 with small white polka dots, outlined in #2B4E43 (8px stroke). Positions: '1' near left column top; '2' below it; '3' near right column top. Under the Step 3 paragraph, a short brush-like underline sweep in desaturated green #8EA993 with rounded ends (~360px long).

nodes.text: Write down your favorite self-care ideas on strips of paper.
Whenever you're feeling down, stressed out, or drained – pull out a strip of paper and then do that activity.
